newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere files new reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere files new reorganization plan.

text.p: Stratosphere Corp said Friday it filed an amended Chapter 11 reorganization plan after Grand Casinos Inc withdraw support from the original.
Stratosphere said it failed to meet minimum consolidated cash flows outlined under the first plan.
The new agreement calls for Grand Casinos receiving 90 percent of the equity interest in the reorganized company, and First Mortgage note holders receiving the remaining 10 percent.
Under the new plan, Grand Casinos would commit to buying up to $25 million in new notes and 36 million shares of class B common stock in the reorganized company.
Note holders would exchange $203 million of outstanding notes for $110 million principal amount of new notes and 10 percent of the equity of the reorganized company
Grand Casinos would pay a total of $50 million for the new shares.

Stratosphere would receive a total of $75 million of proceeds from the sale of stock and notes and would use the cash to add about 1,000 hotel rooms, along with swimming pool and recreation facilities to its Las Vegas resort complex.
Grand Casinos would guarantee an additional $25 million to cover potential cost overruns, and would manage the construction and the day to day operations of Stratosphere for an annual fee.
Under the new plan, Stratosphere has 90 days to solicit alternative restructuring propsals.
